description: A striking, white chandelier with a unique, layered design. The main body of the chandelier is composed of numerous intricate, feather-like elements that hang in cascading rows, creating a dramatic, elongated teardrop shape. These elements have a textured, almost organic appearance, reminiscent of natural forms. At the top, a decorative stem connects to a circular ceiling mount. The overall aesthetic is opulent and detailed, suggesting a piece that would serve as a significant focal point in a room.
